features.name: keyword_present
features.description: 1 if the product appeared in the keyword candidate list.
features.formula: 1 if keyword_rank is not None else 0

features.name: semantic_present
features.description: 1 if the product appeared in the semantic candidate list.
features.formula: 1 if semantic_rank is not None else 0

features.name: retrieval_source_count
features.description: How many retrievers contributed this product (1 or 2).
features.missing_behavior: 0 only if the candidate list is empty (should not occur)

features.name: keyword_score
features.description: Raw PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd. Not a probability.

features.name: semantic_score
features.description: Cosine / inner product on L2-normalized MiniLM vectors.

features.name: keyword_rr
features.description: Reciprocal keyword rank. Rank 1 is better than rank 100.

features.name: semantic_rr
features.description: Reciprocal semantic rank.

features.name: keyword_rank_fraction
features.description: Keyword rank scaled by candidate_k (smaller is better).

features.name: semantic_rank_fraction
features.description: Semantic rank scaled by candidate_k (smaller is better).

features.name: rrf_score
features.description: Reciprocal Rank Fusion score. Reuses rrf_contribution; k0=60.

features.name: weighted_score
features.description: Min-max weighted fusion at alpha=0.5 unless overridden.
features.formula: alpha * K_norm + (1-alpha) * S_norm; per-query min-max inside each list

features.name: title_exact_phrase
features.description: 1 if the normalized query phrase is a substring of the title.
features.formula: 1 if normalize(query) is non-empty and in normalize(title) else 0
features.missing_behavior: 0 if query or title has no remaining text

features.name: title_all_query_tokens
features.description: 1 if every unique query token appears in the title tokens.
features.formula: 1 if query tokens and all of them are in title tokens else 0
features.missing_behavior: 0 if the query has no alphanumeric tokens

features.name: title_overlap_count
features.description: Count of unique query tokens also in the title.
features.missing_behavior: 0 if either side has no tokens

features.name: title_overlap_ratio
features.description: Fraction of unique query tokens found in the title.
features.missing_behavior: 0 if the query has no alphanumeric tokens (no divide-by-zero)

features.name: brand_present
features.description: 1 if the catalog brand field is non-empty. Brand is never inferred from store.
features.formula: 1 if brand is a non-empty string else 0
features.missing_behavior: 0 when brand is null or blank

features.name: brand_exact
features.description: 1 if the normalized brand phrase appears in the normalized query.
features.formula: 1 if brand_present and normalize(brand) in normalize(query) else 0

features.name: brand_overlap
features.description: Fraction of unique query tokens that also appear in the brand tokens.
features.missing_behavior: 0 when brand or query tokens are empty

features.name: description_missing
features.description: 1 if description is null or blank.
features.missing_behavior: 1 when missing (this IS the missingness flag)

features.name: title_token_count
features.description: Number of alphanumeric tokens in the title (repeats counted).

features.name: description_token_count
features.description: Number of alphanumeric tokens in the description.

features.name: average_rating
features.description: Catalog average rating. A prior, not query relevance. 0 when missing.
features.missing_behavior: 0 when missing (this catalog's hybrid candidates all had ratings in E-006)

features.name: log_rating_count
features.description: log1p of rating_count. Deterministic; not a fitted scaler.
features.formula: log1p(rating_count) if rating_count is not None and >= 0 else 0

features.name: price_missing
features.description: 1 if price is null or not positive.
features.formula: 1 if price is None or price <= 0 else 0

features.name: log_price
features.description: log1p(price) when price > 0. No catalog-median imputation.

excluded.interaction_popularity: Deferred from v1. Full-catalog interaction counts would leak future events into later time-aware splits. Cutoff-bounded counts were not added to v1.
excluded.user_features: User affinity is applied by bounded personalized search, not these features.
excluded.subcategory: Field is unused / always empty in this catalog.
excluded.category_match: Dropped from v1 after E-006: category_present was constant (this slice is almost entirely All Beauty) and category_overlap was ~99% zero.
excluded.rating_missing: Dropped from v1 after E-006: every profiled candidate had average_rating.
excluded.labels: Labels are never stored inside the feature vector.
